name: NGC 6627 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6627, the host galaxy of the supernova SN 2021abkm, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6627-hubble
story: A star in this galaxy exploded as SN 2021abkm, a hydrogen-rich (Type II) supernova. Hubble returned to the site to study the stars around it, clues to the kind of star that died.

claims.text: SN 2021abkm's host galaxy is NGC 6627 (host match)
SN 2021abkm is a Type II supernova
Hubble program 17070 imaged SN2021ABKM to resolve the stars around Type II supernovae and estimate progenitor masses
